THE_PROBLEM_RATIFIED_AGAINST.DF-11_as_recorded: RC-9a obliges the executor to record, per plane, what scope or permission its credential carries. A credential's scope is a server-side fact. READS enumerates nine operations and none is a credential-introspection call. RC-10 refuses any operation not enumerated in READS. The executor could therefore not satisfy RC-9a without violating RC-10.
THE_PROBLEM_RATIFIED_AGAINST.why_it_blocked_arming: LIMB_3 of AC-1 requires RC-9a. With DF-11 open, LIMB_3 was unsatisfiable by any disciplined executor, so ARMED could never become true.
THE_PROBLEM_RATIFIED_AGAINST.what_the_owner_was_asked: Whether to authorize a narrow new operation class for credential metadata only, or to narrow RC-9a to facts obtainable without any provider call.

RATIFICATION.signing_party: product owner (human, via directing text in this conversation)
may_observe_ONLY: provider-reported scopes / permissions / role, where exposed
blast-radius metadata derivable from those permissions
RATIFICATION.fail_closed_rule: If provider-reported scope/permission cannot be established verifiably, RC-9a = UNSATISFIED and ARMED = false.
RATIFICATION.inference_prohibition: Successful historical operations MUST NOT be used to infer scope. That an earlier push or pull-request call succeeded is evidence that something worked, never a measurement of what a credential may do.
RATIFICATION.bound_to: AC-1 LIMB_3 / RC-9a ONLY. This class is not a general-purpose read grant.

EXPLICIT_NON_AUTHORIZATIONS: This decision does NOT authorize any of the nine governed DN reads (V-R1..V-R4, G-R1..G-R4, X-R1). The new class is disjoint from them.
It does NOT arm the grant. It removes one obstacle to evaluating LIMB_3; the conjunction AC-1 still governs.
It does NOT authorize M-8, M-9, branch creation, or any Vercel or GitHub settings mutation.
It does NOT authorize reading any environment variable value, deploy-hook URL, project secret, or token material, under any framing.
It does NOT widen RC-9a's definition of scope. Where a provider exposes no verifiable permission model, the answer is UNSATISFIED, not a substitute fact.
It does NOT reopen OD-1..OD-5, RBD-1 or RBD-2.
precedence_note: This record is canonical for owner intent on DF-11 only. The effective read authority (v1.0.0 as amended by v1.0.1 and v1.0.2) continues to control the nine reads, the arming conjunction, and every fail-closed rule. Where this record and that authority could be read to conflict, the authority controls the mechanism and this record controls only whether the introspection class exists.
